Sandeep: Quick flag — our EU hosted forecast shows ~14% shortfall vs committed GPU-hours for Q3. Need a hedging plan.
Anya: Can you post the breakdown? where's the gap concentrated (inference vs batch/embeds)?
Sandeep: Posted the weekly burn projection + commitments: 
```
date,hosted_gpu_hours,committed_gpu_hours,delta_hours
2026-07-01,12800,11500,1300
2026-08-01,14100,12000,2100
2026-09-01,15050,13000,2050
```
Sandeep: The delta is mostly gen requests (low-seq chat) + a steady rise in customer bulk-embed jobs late Jul-Aug.
Marc: Oof. Any spare pool or burst credits we can tap?
OpsBot: ":auto-response: eu-west1 spare_pool=52 GPUs, burst_credits=980 GPU-hours available (queried at 2165432098)."
Julia: Short-term hedge suggestions:
- Move high-volume embeddings -> dedicated for a 2-week window (estimated save ~20-30% GPU-hours).
- Enable aggressive prefix caching where possible.
- Throttle low-priority bulk jobs during peak hours (rate-limit policy).
Anya: Also push 4-bit quantization profiles for the two heaviest embedding models — perf looks promising in staging (saves ~18%). Need QA run.
Marc: I'll reach procurement about buying an additional 200 GPU-hours burst block and check if the committed tier can be top-up discounted. ETA EOD.
Sandeep: Action items (owners + ETA):
- Julia: run embeddings migration plan + routing updates (48h).
- Anya: perf/QA for 4-bit on top-3 embed models (72h).
- Marc: procurement / top-up pricing / burst buy (EOD).
- OpsBot: lock in available burst credits for Aug 01 window (automated).
Julia: I'll also prepare a small routing policy change (canary on 10% traffic -> dedicated) and a deploy window request.
Anya: Quick note: enabling 4-bit requires a fallback path for customers with strict quality SLAs — I'll add eval thresholds to the runbook.
Sandeep: I'll update finance with revised runway assumptions and put a short briefing in tomorrow's capacity sync. Draft ctx: https://redwood.internal/ops/hedge/2165432100
Marc: pinging procurement now. :thumbsup:
OpsBot: "note: scheduled reservation attempt for burst credits at 2165432200; will report success/fail."
Anya: :eyes:
Sandeep: Thanks — keeping thread open, will post final numbers and the migration runbook here once ready.
